Fill in all required personal, educational, and identity details completely, as partial entries are not permitted.
Upload a recent colour photograph and signature as specified.
Provide details of one identity document - Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or PAN Card (Aadhaar is preferred/desired).
Pay the application fee of Rs. 100 through the online payment gateway.
Submit the form before the deadline; the application is considered final only after successful fee payment.

content_sections.heading: Deoghar Home Guard Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The vacancies below are described in the notification as provisional in nature and may be revised (increased, decreased, or modified) without prior notice. 50% of posts in both Rural and Urban Home Guard categories are earmarked for women. In the Urban Home Guard category, 50% of vacancies are earmarked for technically skilled candidates. If suitable candidates are not available in one sub-category (technical/non-technical), the vacancy will be filled from the other. Of the posts earmarked for women, 5% are reserved for eligible divorced/deserted/widowed women candidates. If such candidates are not available, these posts revert to the general women's quota. content_sections.heading: Deoghar Home Guard Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Rural Home Guard: The candidate must be a permanent resident of the same block in Deoghar district from which they are applying, supported by a self-attested residence certificate issued by the competent authority. Urban Home Guard: The candidate must be an ordinary resident of the urban area of Deoghar district, supported by a self-attested residence certificate issued by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Deoghar Home Guard Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 19 and 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026 for both Rural and Urban Home Guard posts. The notification does not specify any separate upper age relaxation for reserved categories. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Deoghar Home Guard Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach self-attested certificates supporting their claimed educational qualification. Candidates seeking relaxation in physical standards must attach a caste certificate issued by the competent authority. Candidates applying for the technically skilled Urban Home Guard vacancies must be skilled in a technical field and either employed in a related office or self-employed with relevant technical knowledge. The notification lists the following as generally recognised technical categories: doctor, engineer, advocate, lecturer/professor, nurse, computer operator, typist, licensed driver (HMV/LMV), cook, carpenter, cobbler, washerman, barber, electrician, gardener, plumber, and similar trades. A technical proficiency certificate issued by the competent authority is required.

content_sections.heading: Deoghar Home Guard Salary / Allowance
content_sections.text: As stated explicitly in the notification, this is a voluntary enrolment and not a salaried government post. There is no fixed monthly salary. Enrolled Home Guards receive a duty allowance at rates fixed by the government, paid only for the number of days they are actually deployed on duty as required.

content_sections.heading: Deoghar Home Guard Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted as per the Home Department, Government of Jharkhand notification No. 5442 dated 20.10.2014, through the following stages: Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Comprising a 1-mile race, high jump, long jump, and shot put, with marks awarded on a sliding scale for each event. Separate scoring standards apply for (i) Rural and Non-Technical Urban candidates, and (ii) Technically skilled Urban candidates, with separate benchmarks for male and female candidates in each. Hindi Writing Ability Test: Qualifying in nature, for candidates who clear the PET. Rural candidates are tested at a 7th-class level and Urban candidates at a 10th-class level. Full marks: 100; qualifying marks: 30. Technical Skill Test: Applicable only to technically skilled Urban Home Guard candidates who clear the PET and Hindi Writing Test. Qualifying in nature. Full marks: 100; qualifying marks: 30. Merit List, Document Verification, Medical Examination & Police Verification: A merit list is prepared based on the notified provisions after all tests are completed, and selection is made against available vacancies. Selected candidates' certificates, medical fitness, and police character verification are checked before appointment. Basic Training & Enrolment: Selected candidates undergo basic Home Guard training on the orders of JGRV Headquarters, Ranchi. On successful completion of training, they are formally enrolled as Home Guards and issued an enrolment certificate. Government servants may be enrolled as Urban Home Guards up to a limit of 10% of the total Urban Home Guard vacancies. Marks are awarded based on educational qualification:

faq.question: Q1. What is Deoghar Home Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. 01/2026 issued by the Jharkhand Griha Raksha Vahini (JGRV), Deoghar, inviting online applications for enrolment of Home Guards (Grih Rakshak) in Rural and Urban categories across Deoghar district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 772 provisional vacancies in total - 635 Rural Home Guard posts and 137 Urban Home Guard posts. The notification states this number can be revised without prior notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 26.10.2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Minimum 7th class pass for Rural Home Guard and minimum Matric (10th class) pass for Urban Home Guard.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be 19 to 40 years old as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 100, payable online through the payment gateway on the official website.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: By visiting recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in and submitting the appropriate Rural or Urban Home Guard application form along with the required documents and fee, before 26.10.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Physical Efficiency Test, qualifying Hindi Writing Ability Test, a qualifying Technical Skill Test (Urban technical candidates only), followed by merit-list preparation, document/medical/police verification, and basic training before final enrolment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Deoghar Home Guard?
faq.answer: There is no fixed salary. This is a voluntary enrolment, and selected Home Guards receive only a government-prescribed duty allowance for days actually spent on duty.
